privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.seoDesc: How Quarterfold Printabilities collects, uses and protects the personal data you share on this site, aligned with India's DPDP Act, GDPR, PIPEDA and CCPA.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Quarterfold Printabilities Private Limited ("Quarterfold", "we", "us") handles personal data collected through this website. We act as the Data Fiduciary for that data and process it lawfully, fairly and only for the purposes described below. Because visitors reach us from several countries, this policy is written to meet India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the UK and EU GDPR, Canada's PIPEDA and California's CCPA/CPRA together.

p: Quarterfold Printabilities Private Limited (CIN U74999MH2020PTC337494) is the Data Fiduciary responsible for personal data collected through this site.
Registered office: Office No 1207, Plot No 4 & 6, Sector 30A, Cyber One IT Park, Vashi, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400703, India.
For any privacy question or request, or to reach our privacy contact point, email info@quarterfoldltd.com.

We collect only the information you choose to submit through our enquiry and quote forms. We run no analytics and set no cookies, so we do not build a profile of your visit. The only data created automatically is the standard technical information any website receives when your browser makes a request:
list: Details you enter in a form: your name, email address, phone number, company (where provided) and the message or project notes you write.

Standard request data such as your IP address, browser type and the time of the request. This comes from no analytics tool; it is the ordinary information our hosting provider may record in server logs to keep the site secure and running, and we do not use it to identify or track individual visitors.

p: We use the information you provide to:
list: respond to your enquiry and prepare a quotation, sample or proposal;
send you communications you have asked for or consented to receive;
operate, maintain, secure and improve this website; and
meet our legal, regulatory and accounting obligations.

p: We rely on the lawful basis that fits each purpose and your location. We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use it for marketing without your consent.
list: Consent, which you give when you submit a form or opt in to communications, and which you can withdraw at any time (UK and EU GDPR Article 6(1)(a); India's DPDP Act, 2023; Canada's PIPEDA).
Our legitimate interests in responding to you, running the site and keeping it secure, weighed against your rights (UK and EU GDPR Article 6(1)(f)).
Compliance with a legal obligation, where the law requires us to keep or disclose data (UK and EU GDPR Article 6(1)(c)).

p: For California residents: we process personal information only for the business purposes described above. We do not sell or share your personal information as those terms are defined under the CCPA/CPRA, and we will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.
For visitors in Canada: we collect, use and disclose personal information with your knowledge and consent, as required by PIPEDA, and only for the purposes set out here.

We share your data only with the service providers that help us operate the site and respond to you, and only as far as needed to provide those services. These currently include our form-delivery provider (Web3Forms), our content platform (Sanity), our website host, and the font and map-tile providers your browser loads directly. They act on our instructions or their own published terms.
We may also disclose data where required by law, regulation or court order, or to establish or protect our legal rights.
This website is operated from India, and the personal data you submit is processed in India.

Some of the service providers that help us run the site are located in other countries, so your data may be transferred outside India, the UK and the EU to them. Where it is, we rely on the lawful bases above and on appropriate safeguards, such as the provider's contractual data-protection commitments.

In particular, to display the site your browser loads fonts from Google (Google Fonts) and, on some pages, map tiles and article content from other providers. These providers receive your IP address directly from your browser as a normal part of delivering their content. They are not sent your form data and, in our checks, they set no cookies.

We keep the enquiry and quote details you submit for up to 24 months after our last contact about your request, unless a longer period is needed to meet our legal, accounting or statutory obligations. After that we delete or anonymise the data. Where our hosting provider keeps server logs, they are retained only for the short period needed to keep the site secure and running.
Subject to the law that applies to you, you may ask us to:
list: access the personal data we hold about you;
correct or update data that is inaccurate or incomplete;
erase your data where it is no longer required;
provide a copy of the data you gave us in a portable, machine-readable format;
object to, or ask us to restrict, certain processing;
withdraw a consent you have given, at any time; and
nominate another person to exercise your rights in the event of death or incapacity, as provided under India's DPDP Act.

p: To exercise any of these rights, email us at info@quarterfoldltd.com and we will respond within the timelines the law requires.
If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the supervisory authority for your region:
list: India: the Data Protection Board of India;
United Kingdom: the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO);
California: the California Privacy Protection Agency, or the California Attorney General;
Canada: the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

p: This site is intended for a business audience and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect the personal data of children. If you believe a child has provided us with data, contact us and we will delete it.

We apply reasonable technical and organisational safeguards to protect personal data against loss, misuse and unauthorised access. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, but we work to protect your data using appropriate measures.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The current version is always available on this page, with the date it was last updated shown below.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.seoDesc: Quarterfold Printabilities sets no cookies. The site keeps only three functional items to remember your choices, with no analytics or tracking.
cookies.intro: In plain terms: this website sets no cookies at all. It runs no analytics or advertising trackers and does not track you across other websites. The only things it keeps are three functional items saved in your browser's local storage to remember your choices, listed in full below.

p: These three items live in your browser's local storage. They are first-party (set by Quarterfold, not by anyone else), hold only your own preferences, and stay until you clear your browser. None of them is a cookie.

rows: Records whether you accepted or declined this banner, so you are not asked again.
Until you clear your browser storage
Remembers whether you read the site in English, French or Spanish. Saved only if you change the language.
Until you clear your browser storage
Remembers whether you muted the site's typing sound. Saved only if you change it.
Until you clear your browser storage

p: To show you the site, your browser loads a few things directly from other providers. Because your browser contacts them itself, they receive your IP address, but none of them sets any cookies:
list: Google Fonts serves the site's typefaces on every page.
OpenFreeMap serves map tiles, only on the pages that show the interactive globe.
Sanity serves the images and articles in the Newsroom, only when you open it.
Web3Forms delivers your message when you submit the enquiry form.

sections.h: What this site does not use
p: No advertising or marketing cookies, and no third-party analytics or tracking tools such as Google Analytics or Meta Pixel. Because there is nothing non-essential to switch on or off, declining the banner changes nothing about how the site works for you. If we ever add a non-essential tool, it will load only after you consent through the banner.

sections.h: Managing and clearing what is stored
p: You can clear or block this local storage at any time through your browser settings:
list: Chrome: Settings, then Privacy and security, then Clear browsing data.
Firefox: Settings, then Privacy & Security, then Cookies and Site Data, then Clear Data.
Safari: Settings, then Privacy, then Manage Website Data (or Clear History).
Edge: Settings, then Cookies and site permissions, then Manage and delete cookies and site data.

p: If what the site stores ever changes, we will update this page and the date shown below.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.seoDesc: Quarterfold Printabilities targets WCAG 2.1 AA: contrast, keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support and readable text across the site.
accessibility.intro: Quarterfold Printabilities is committed to making this website usable for as many people as possible, including people who rely on assistive technologies. We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at Level AA.

p: We build and maintain the site with accessibility in mind, including:
list: Colour contrast that aims to meet WCAG 2.1 AA for text and interface elements.
Full keyboard navigation, a visible focus indicator and a "skip to content" link.
Support for reduced motion: animations are minimised when your device requests it.
Readable, scalable text with sensible minimum sizes, plus semantic, screen-reader-friendly structure and alternative text for meaningful images.

p: We are honest that no site is ever perfectly accessible. Some richer, animated or third-party embedded content may not yet fully conform, and we treat any such gaps as issues to fix. We continue to test and improve the site over time.

If you encounter an accessibility barrier on this site, or need information in a different format, please tell us at info@quarterfoldltd.com. We welcome your feedback and aim to respond promptly and put things right where we can.
We will update this statement as the site evolves and as we address the points above. The date it was last updated is shown below.
